method: Two independent read-only code audits of every path that can INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE the identity, programme, season, coach, roster and seniors tables, then spot-verified by hand (write statements, DELETE-all rebuilds, the Saint Francis (IL) crosswalk regression, runtime coach read path). No institution-level secrets; no personal data.

flags_legend.UNSAFE: can write wrong facts on normal use
flags_legend.BYPASS: writes canonical tables without the athletics-entity model
flags_legend.INFERRED_DATA: writes values nobody observed (patterns, current-state stamped on history, mocks)

status_legend.CLOSED_GUARDED: Phase 7E: refuses to write on an integrity-managed database unless --legacy-write-ack --reason; the monitor must run afterwards
status_legend.CLOSED_ROUTE: Phase 7E: HTTP route returns 409 on an integrity-managed database (no override on the product surface)
status_legend.LEGACY_APPLIER: one-off reviewed fixture applier from Phases 3-7 (expected-old guards, one transaction); not re-runnable against moved data
status_legend.RESIDUAL_OPEN: left open deliberately, with the reason
